# Showcase Multi-Window Dock Layouts, JSON-first LLM fluency, and 459-class platform breadth in MultiWindow.md and Features.md

## Problem

Following the `v13.4` release-blocker audit on #20519 (`#20496` / `#20498`), two core Body benefit pages — `learn/benefits/body/MultiWindow.md` (`64` lines) and `learn/benefits/body/Features.md` (`65` lines) — predate `v13.2` and severely undersell what Neo.mjs ships today:

1. **`learn/benefits/body/MultiWindow.md` never mentions Multi-Window Dock Layouts (`src/dock/`) or live cross-window runtime embodiment:**
   - Neo.mjs ships a `44`-class multi-window Dock Layouts subsystem (`src/dock/`) and a comprehensive Dock Layouts curriculum (`learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts.md`, `DockLayoutsAdoption.md`, `DockLayoutsStateAndPersistence.md`, `DockLayoutsPanes.md`, `DockLayoutsWindows.md`, `DockLayoutsStyling.md`, `DockLayoutsMechanics.md`, `DockLayoutsFeatures.md`, `learn/guides/testing/DockLayoutsTesting.md`, `learn/tutorials/DockLayoutsFirstLayout.md`, and `learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md`), where live component instances tear out into secondary browser windows, re-dock across monitors, and persist workspace perspectives on a single `SharedWorker` heap without losing state.
   - `MultiWindow.md` never mentions `src/dock/`, links none of the Dock Layouts guides or tutorial, and omits how AI peers inspect and manipulate multi-window topologies live through the **[Neural Link (`Possession Interface`)](../../agentos/NeuralLink.md)**.

2. **`learn/benefits/body/Features.md` reads like a thin pre-AI feature summary that omits platform breadth, JSON-first LLM fluency, and Two-Hemisphere embodiment:**
   - `Features.md:11` restricts `Multi-Window Applications` to *"complex enterprise applications requiring sophisticated multi-screen workflows"* without mentioning Multi-Window Dock Layouts (`src/dock/`, `44` classes) or everyday desktop/mobile web applications.
   - `Features.md:34-40` (`## Powerful Component Library`) mentions only *"nested lazy-loaded forms"* and theming — omitting the `459`-class / `39`-namespace platform breadth (`100,000`-row buffered grids in `src/grid/`, `26` form field types in `src/form/field/`, `28` calendar classes in `src/calendar/`, `44` dock classes in `src/dock/`, `8` layouts in `src/layout/`, `38` main-thread addons in `src/main/addon/`, and direct comparisons to [Angular, React, or Vue](../../comparisons/Overview.md) and [Ext JS](../../comparisons/NeoVsExtJs.md)).
   - `Features.md` never mentions that Neo.mjs has been **JSON-first since its November 2019 GA** ([`JSONFirstUIs.md`](JSONFirstUIs.md)) — why LLMs natively excel at authoring and mutating Neo.mjs UIs without the pre-AI human complexity burden — or how the Body connects to **[The Brain](../Introduction.md)** and the **[Neural Link (`Possession Interface`)](../../agentos/NeuralLink.md)** for live runtime embodiment.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (`learn/benefits/body/MultiWindow.md`):** Upgrades `MultiWindow.md` to showcase **Multi-Window Dock Layouts (`src/dock/` — `44` classes)** — live cross-window tear-out, re-docking, and workspace perspective persistence on a single `SharedWorker` heap — with relative links to the Dock Layouts guides (`../../guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts.md`, `../../guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsWindows.md`, `../../guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsStateAndPersistence.md`, `../../tutorials/DockLayoutsFirstLayout.md`, `../../agentos/DockZoneModel.md`) and live multi-window runtime inspection & embodiment via the **[Neural Link](../../agentos/NeuralLink.md)** while preserving the existing `live-preview` code block.
- [ ] **AC-2 (`learn/benefits/body/Features.md`):** Upgrades `Features.md` to present Neo.mjs as a complete `459`-class platform across `39` namespaces for every desktop and mobile web application (linking [Angular, React, or Vue](../../comparisons/Overview.md) and [Ext JS](../../comparisons/NeoVsExtJs.md)), highlights Multi-Window Dock Layouts (`src/dock/`, `44` classes), `100,000`-row buffered grids (`src/grid/`), `26` form field types (`src/form/field/`), `38` main-thread addons (`src/main/addon/`), explains why **JSON-first since the November 2019 GA** ([`JSONFirstUIs.md`](JSONFirstUIs.md)) makes LLMs natively excel at Neo.mjs (eliminating pre-AI worker complexity), and links **[The Brain](../Introduction.md)** + **[Neural Link](../../agentos/NeuralLink.md)** for live runtime embodiment.
- [ ] **AC-3 (No Niche Gatekeeping or Legacy Flattery):** Neither file frames Neo.mjs as an exotic niche-only tool or flatters legacy single-threaded libraries (`React`, `Angular`, `Vue`) as "modern".
- [ ] **AC-4 (Static Verification):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with zero errors, and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` + `apps/portal/llms.txt` remain untouched.

## Design Rationale

- **Why combine `MultiWindow.md` and `Features.md` into one ticket:** Both files live in `learn/benefits/body/`, neither was touched by `#20519` (`d6006f42eb` only touched the other 7 files in `learn/benefits/body/`), and both suffer from the exact same pre-`v13.2` gap (missing the `44`-class `src/dock/` Multi-Window Dock Layouts subsystem, the `459`-class platform inventory, JSON-first LLM fluency, and Neural Link runtime embodiment). Grouping them into a single atomic ticket keeps our open issue count low for the `v13.4` release gate (`#20496`) and avoids any file overlap with the sibling `README.md` + `guide-authoring-bar.md` ticket.

## Avoided Traps

- **Do NOT invent non-existent Dock Layout guide filenames** (e.g. `DockLayoutsOverview.md` or `DockLayoutsMultiWindow.md` do not exist; verify against `learn/tree.json`: `DockLayouts.md`, `DockLayoutsAdoption.md`, `DockLayoutsStateAndPersistence.md`, `DockLayoutsPanes.md`, `DockLayoutsWindows.md`, `DockLayoutsStyling.md`, `DockLayoutsMechanics.md`, `DockLayoutsFeatures.md`, `learn/tutorials/DockLayoutsFirstLayout.md`, and `learn/agentos/DockZoneModel.md`).
- **Do NOT remove the `javascript live-preview` block in `MultiWindow.md`.**
- **Do NOT touch `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.**
